metadata.title: Coastal Portrait with Expressive Hand-Lettered Footer

retrievalProfile.description: A split-frame composition featuring a warm, close-up beach portrait above a solid black footer containing expressive, jagged hand-lettering.
triggerTerms: beach portrait with black text footer
warm sunset portrait with rough typography
excludeWhen: clean minimalist sans-serif layouts are required
full-bleed photography without a footer is requested
high-contrast neon color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical layout where the top two-thirds is a soft-focus, warm-toned portrait of a woman on a beach, and the bottom third is a solid black block featuring rough, gestural hand-lettering in contrasting colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal division between photographic and graphic zones
Contrast between soft photographic skin tones and sharp, jagged letterforms
Color coordination between the subject's clothing and the primary title text
Warm natural light in the image versus stark artificial black in the footer
coreInvariants: Solid black rectangular footer occupying the bottom third of the frame
Rough, hand-drawn letterforms with visible brush or ink texture
Warm, golden-hour lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait centered horizontally, filling the upper photographic section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold, colored hand-lettering in the footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the vibrant red lettering, then across the white title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid black footer provides significant negative space for the graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and sandy beiges in the photograph.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black in the footer area.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red/terracotta for the primary name and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and moderate saturation in the photo; low value and high contrast in the footer.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Irregular, expressive script with varying baseline and x-height.
letterConstructionRules: Jagged, torn-paper edges on all strokes
Inconsistent stroke weights suggesting a dry brush or ink nib
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated and sharp
Internal counters are often reduced to small slits
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using the same distressed lettering style for both primary and secondary text.
graphicDevices: Technical metadata logos centered at the very bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, expressive energy of the original lettering.
Mimics the sharp, carved appearance of the glyphs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned, soft-focus portrait of a woman on a beach at sunset, leaving the bottom 30% of the frame as a solid black rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-lettered text in the black footer area using a jagged, distressed style; use terracotta red for the first word and cream for the remaining phrase.

verificationChecks: Is the footer a solid, opaque black?
Does the lettering have a rough, non-digital texture?
Is the portrait lighting warm and golden?
Is the text color-coded according to the hierarchy?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Authentic film-grain texture in the photo
Convincing hand-drawn quality in the type

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the jagged style
Ensure the black footer is perfectly horizontal
Verify the warm color temperature of the photograph
Confirm the absence of any modern digital artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned film portrait with a high-contrast black footer containing expressive, distressed hand-lettering.
